details:
Flood Detective is a web-based prototype designed to help people understand and monitor flood risk in Türkiye’s Marmara Region. We analyze NASA satellite precipitation data alongside historical flood records to investigate rainfall trends and their relationship with flood events. Our goal is to turn complex environmental data into clear information that people can use to take precautions.

On our website, users can select a city in the Marmara Region and view its estimated daily and monthly flood probabilities as percentages. The planned early warning system will send an SMS or mobile notification when the estimated risk exceeds a defined threshold. These messages will also include practical safety instructions, helping users understand what to do during a potential flood.

Our project addresses the “Be an Earth System Trend Detective” challenge by exploring patterns in Earth observation data and connecting them to a local environmental problem. Its main benefits are making flood risk information more accessible, increasing disaster awareness, and supporting earlier precautions. We aim to help communities become better prepared for floods and support informed decisions alongside official warnings.

We used NASA Giovanni to access and explore satellite precipitation data and examined historical disaster records to identify past flood events. We used Python to process and analyze the data, with assistance from Claude in developing and improving our code. Our web prototype is hosted on Netlify.

The creative aspect of Flood Detective is the connection between space-based data, city-level risk estimates, and practical guidance. Users can explore information about their own city, understand the estimated risk, and receive instructions through the planned notification system. This connects environmental analysis with a simple and practical user experience.

During development, our team considered data availability, data quality, differences between cities, and the need for a clear interface. We also considered the limitations of using rainfall data to estimate flood risk. Flooding can be influenced by terrain, drainage systems, soil conditions, and urban development, so rainfall alone cannot fully explain every event. Further development will focus on incorporating additional environmental factors, validating our estimates against recorded floods, and testing the early warning system. We aim to communicate uncertainty clearly and improve the prototype’s reliability before wider use.
